name: Reduce, Reuse, Reconcile
summary: Knaz Blunderflame asks you to fetch crude oil from Venture Co. operations at Lake Nazferiti. He wants it to give his homemade racer an extra kick for the races in Thousand Needles.

sections.title: Oil for the Racer
sections.body: Knaz Blunderflame has built a racer on his own, and he plans to take it to the races in Thousand Needles. He asks you to obtain crude oil from the Venture Co. operations at Lake Nazferiti to give it more power.

faq.q: Who is asking for crude oil?
faq.answer: Knaz Blunderflame asks you to acquire crude oil for his homemade racer.

faq.q: Why does Knaz want the oil?
faq.answer: Knaz wants to give his racer an extra kick before taking it to the races in Thousand Needles.
The crude oil is at Venture Co. operations by Lake Nazferiti.
Knaz has designed and built a racer himself.
